■Direction
"......" is a brief hesitation before deciding, since it's her favorite drink

■Direction
Second line proudly

■Direction
Can't make up her mind because she really wants carrot lassi after all

■Direction
"..." in line 1 is a brief moment of hesitation at the Trainer's words.

I mean, heroes are supposed to save people!
Throwing a selfish fit would disqualify me as a hero, right?

Heheh, you think so...!
Well then, chee—

You two...! Thank you, I've had one failure after another lately.
But I'm going to give it another shot!

! ...Yeah, thanks! But I'm good,
a hero doesn't rely on being pampered by others!

Yeah! Thanks to you, Trainer,
I was able to protect the academy's peace way more than usual!
! ...Yeah!

No need to worry about me!
There are plenty of other juices I'd like to drink anyway!

Hnnh... oof!
All right, that's the last one!

You'll come with me?! Hooray! With you around, Trainer, we're a hundred times stronger!
Let's protect the peace of Tracen Academy together!

Ah, Trainer! Heheh...
While I was on my patrol of justice, I heard someone calling for a hero!

Huh...?! N-No, I can't take that!
That was meant for you...!

I was having trouble carrying it all by myself, but Biko-san
helped me out... It was a huge lifesaver!

Hey, Senpai! If you'd like,
please take my carrot lassi!

Huh... Whaaat?! Is the carrot lassi
sold out again...?

Seeing that senpai smile was the best reward I could ever get!
That's more than enough for Justice Biko!

While I was counting supplies in the storeroom, Biko Pegasus appeared.
With her small frame, she was carrying a huge package...

Step by step, she was drawing closer to the hero she admired.
...Yet at the same time, I found myself wanting to be there to support her.

I'll be totally fine! More importantly, you've got a race tomorrow, right?
Then drink this and give it your all!

Still... I wondered if she was really okay after looking forward to it so much.
As I worried about her...

It's my absolute favorite! It's always sold out in no time,
but today they just happened to have one left!
Besides, something great happened too.
...After that, I continued helping Biko Pegasus—

You're a lifesaver! We have an unusually hungry crowd today.
Thanks to this, we should be able to manage!

It looked like Biko Pegasus was doing her rounds around Tracen Academy.
I wondered if there was anything I could do to help...

Umm~... Hmmm...
Ah, ahaha! It's so hard to choose!

! ...Thank you, I won't forget this!
I'll definitely win tomorrow's race!

Drinking that was how I found the strength to push through my races...
Wh-What should I do? Tomorrow's race is going to be a disaster...!

Hey, hey, did you see that?!
That senpai looked so happy!

Now's the time! Pegasus Burning!
Don't give up, get back on your feet!

Here goes! Pegasus Hurricane!
Taaaaaahhhh!!

Ta-daaa! Check it out—
it's the "Carotene-Packed Carrot Lassi"!

All right, that wraps up today's patrol!
...Heheh~♪
